prompt:
Transparent atlas, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS AND ONE ROW. Four horizontal floor-tile edge elevations, one per column, in strict order FRONT / RIGHT / LEFT / REAR. The tile is a flat horizontal L-shaped civic-stone corner. IMPORTANT: all FOUR edge profiles must have exactly the SAME physical edge length and exactly the SAME shallow Z thickness. Each profile should consist of exactly FOUR adjoining broad pale-cream limestone blocks across the length, one narrow warm-gold trim stripe, and one shallow charcoal-gray foundation band. Do not use two-block edge rows or four differently sized views. No posts, tall end caps, tall vertical edges, or upright L-shaped walls. Every cell must be a narrow, level, horizontal orthographic edge profile; a direct camera at edge height shows NO broad top plane and NO tile plan.

Match the supplied native top source: pale cream limestone blocks, gold thin inset/trim edge, charcoal stone backing, restrained weathering. The L footprint belongs only to the TOP/BOTTOM plan and is not visible as a standing L in these lateral elevations. The source has no blue ornament or badge, so do not add one. Keep four-block run length consistent in every view; arrange only subtle seams/chips to distinguish front/back without changing scale. Four isolated cells on transparent background, each centered at the same baseline.

Negative: any overhead top view, broad square tile plane, isometric perspective, sloped surface, vertical corner post, raised block at an end, blue crest, medallion, props, environment, text, panel lines.
